hero.title: The lightweight template for Umamusume launches
hero.subtitle: Start with ready-to-ship SEO, legal pages, and a content framework tuned for trainers. Swap text and assets, run the checklist, and publish.
hero.support: Each checklist item links back to this repository so you can re-run the setup any time a new campaign launches.

features.title: What comes ready out of the box
features.description: These sections map directly to content files so you can update text, imagery, and priority links without touching components.

items.title: Centralised configuration
items.description: Site name, navigation, SEO defaults, and social links are in one place so handoff takes minutes.

items.title: Reusable sections
items.description: Hero, feature highlights, CTA, and quick links share the same schema across landing pages.

items.title: Writer-first blog
items.description: Markdown with frontmatter for SEO metadata, reading time, related articles, and structured data.

links.title: Jump straight into customising
links.description: Use these links as a mini checklist when preparing a new deployment.

cta.title: Ready to launch your next Umamusume project?
cta.description: Clone this template, customise the sections, run the preflight checklist, and go live in record time.
